cues: Laxminarayan is the central comic figure: a bully at home and a slave at court, clever and quick, but with the courage of the frightened; he lies because he dares not tell the truth.
Jitman and Gore are the voice of the common people: they do the work and sleep on straw, and they turn out to be excellent weepers when their lives depend on it.
The king is young, absolute and easily moved by a show of loyalty.
And the bull itself is dead from the start, the silent pivot of the plot.
